fusions.name: Fanned Shots
fusions.desc: Fires 2 shots at once, slightly apart, each dealing 6 damage up to 9 tiles away. It holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Sudden Report
fusions.desc: Fires a single shot up to 10 tiles that deals 32 damage, ignoring armour. You move 30% faster for 4 seconds after firing.

fusions.name: Itchy Trigger Finger
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Spare Pistol
fusions.desc: When you strike, a shot leaps to the nearest enemy within 9 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
